summary: 12 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. Chat.tsx auto-creates session via POST /api/v1/chat/sessions and navigates with replace:true (lines 12-23). useChatStream uses fetch (not EventSource) so it can attach Authorization header (line 68-77). SSE parse: split on '\n\n', leftover stays in buffer (line 101-102) — handles partial chunks correctly. [DONE] terminator (line 107-110). Malformed JSON: try/catch in JSON.parse with `continue` (lines 112-116). AbortController stored in ref; abort() called before each new send (line 61); AbortError filtered in catch (lines 79, 121). All 5 event types (intent/delta/tool_use/tool_result/error) handled in applyEvent. tool_result correctly maps by id and updates the matching toolCall.

defects.description: untestable_in_static_review — needs network mock + React Testing Library.
Subtle: setState in `finally` (line 125) runs even on successful [DONE] return path. Effect: redundant but idempotent setState. Not a defect, but minor wasted re-render.
defects.actual: Line 108 already sets isStreaming=false, then line 125 sets it again. Idempotent.

notes: Confirmed: SSE protocol matches backend exactly — 5 event types + [DONE] terminator. Cross-referenced services/chat.py SSE emission.
Token retrieved via getToken() from auth/tokenStorage — NOT prop-drilled. Good separation.
